_readme: downstream-consumers-of-placement: static grep of the HEAD export (docs/filigree, docs/living, docs/street, docs/mobile, POLISH.md, tools/*.js) for city anchor coordinates (Epēshu 1236.1/1415; Summarch 523/58 literal and its ◉ 542/52; the top-10 off-dot names Penthelon, Damoklir, Paga, Pontoron, Zhomphek, Philider, Permūr, Hordon, Līrider, Dargan), FOOT_R-derived numbers (48.46, 52, 26, 14, 80.77, cityMaxZ), chart-pois, overlay-Epeshu, overlay-Summarch, cityBox, city-anchors and cityLabels, plus the cells and gates they feed. Verdict per hit: yes = the scenario changes the number/gate; no = it does not; conditional = depends on how/where it is implemented (reason given). (a) = an entry of maps-site/data/city-anchors.json (or the meshedWorldInit Summarch/Penthelon literals) moves; (b) = a canon translate+scale override changes the bounds of a canon overlay (Epēshu/Summarch) away from cityBox(anchor, FOOT_R) while the anchor stays; (c) = a seam clip (coast/land mask clip of the overlay or wash edge). REGISTRATION (where art/geometry sits vs the atlas) is what (a)/(b) change; the RENDERING MEDIUM (raster vs vector) changes none of these numbers by itself: a vector city placed through the same cityBox leaves every row below unchanged except byte/shot keys.

bible_question.finding: Any edit to density-bible.md/.json re-opens the Filigree 1 gate: gates/1-research.json G1.1 requires 'validator sha256 = integrator sha256 (64-hex) for both bible files', and README says a rerun returns pass:true only 'on a bible that still re-hashes'; Job 2 rewrites its Sections when 'the bible sha ... changed'.
bible_question.path_amend: Adding 'Filigree data — city art registration' to density-bible prerequisites (or rewriting city_grain.contour_hill.gap / q08-c08 numbers) = Filigree 1 re-run (re-integration) before Filigree 2.
bible_question.path_no_amend: Queue the item only in POLISH.md, directly above Filigree 3 per R21; Job 2 skips any item 'if POLISH.md already has "Filigree data — <item>"', so it is honoured without touching the bible. The stale q08-c01/c08 and q03-c05 numbers then stay as dated research, superseded by a registration doc outside docs/filigree.
bible_question.which_triggers_amend: (b) on Epēshu necessarily invalidates q08-c01, q08-c08, q03-c05 (cited by bible rules B-33/B-38 city_grain); (a) on Hordon/Gehon Or/Gehon Iepīr may change the window calibration counts in the bible's Calibration line; (c) touches only B-57's wash if implemented in washMake.

open_questions: Do the target hexes of the in-window moves (Hordon 35,52; Gehon Or 48,39; Gehon Iepīr 46,38) classify as coast/sea before the anchor tests under the ten-test order? Run node tools/filigree-dem.js --bbox on each to see if the bible's window calibration counts change.
Will the registration item move Epēshu's anchor at all (it is within 3 px)? If not, every Epēshu row is (b)/(c)-only.
Will the override be applied in one place that both the imageOverlay bounds and buildWorldPOIs/worldPOICoord/cityMaxZ read (keeping POI halos on printed badges), or only to the image?

If an atlas anchor moves (Tamaron, Lepon the Old), does the sim's CUSTOM_MAP_DATA move too (keeping q13-c02 identity, but moving the UG3 simDays fingerprint and Street baselines) or does the sim stay (breaking LC7/continuity)?
q03-c05's cityMaxZ 10.336 uses the 4200-px detail chart; live cityMaxZ for the Epēshu overlay is NZ+log2(3072/52)=9.885. Which one do Filigree 2 sampling zooms adopt?
